claim: COROS supports data sharing in alignment with EU data protection regulations.
quote: COROS supports automated data sharing and API access for third-party platforms authorized by our users, in alignment with EU data protection regulations (including GDPR and the EU Data Act).

claim: COROS uses a standardized, objective onboarding process.
quote: We manage third-party API access through a standardized, objective developer onboarding process.

claim: Rather than custom integrations or manual selection reviews, access goes to any platform meeting standard requirements.
quote: Rather than building custom integrations or conducting manual selection reviews, we grant access through our standard OAuth 2.0 API framework to any platform that satisfies our standard security and operational requirements.

claim: Building on the MCP needs no application or approval.
quote: No application or approval required.

claim: Users connect their COROS account and grant access to their own data.
quote: Implement OAuth 2.0 in your app, and your users can connect their COROS account and grant access to their own data.

quote: MCP server endpoint: https://mcp.coros.com/mcp

claim: MCP access is scoped to the authorizing user only.
quote: All data access is scoped to the authorizing user only (single-user)

quote: COROS uses the standard OAuth 2.0 protocol. Any OAuth 2.0 client library in your language of choice will work.
